name: Daily maintenance

description:
The monthly billing closes the past month's billing period with one invoice per household, holding the household's
  PBS number and address. The accountant link opens the period and its CSV file without a login.

elements.name: The invoices name their household, add up their transactions and are ordered by address, then PBS number

steps.name: the admin is signed in
a season is active
the past month has unbilled orders in 2 households
the MONTHLY_BILLING job has run 1 time
each invoice of the period names its household and PBS number
the invoices of the period are ordered by address, then PBS number
the transactions of each invoice add up to its amount

the MONTHLY_BILLING job has run 1 time

name: Monthly billing

description:
The monthly billing job bills the past month into its billing period, archives the period's CSV and emails the
  accountant, once per version of the period. An admin's re-send emails the accountant again. The archive and each
  email write one delivery record.

name: Billing notifications

description:
Past a dinner's booking deadline, the waiting list and the sales email the inhabitants they concern, once per version
  of the subject. An email about an inhabitant goes to the inhabitant's closest user: the inhabitant's own user, else
  the first user of the inhabitant's household. A delivery record is written per email sent; the DAILY_MAINTENANCE job
  sends the unsent notifications of the dinners.

elements.name: The dinner is booked before the deadline: WAITLIST_JOINED email to the closest user of the inhabitant

steps.name: the admin is signed in
a season of its own is active
a dinner before its BOOKING_CLOSED deadline
the seller has a ticket
an inhabitant without a ticket
0 inhabitants are on the waiting list
0 tickets are for sale
the dinner is booked
0 delivery records are in the database for the dinner
0 WAITLIST_JOINED emails are sent to the closest user of the inhabitant

name: Booking notifications

description:
A chef's dinner has deadlines: the menu is published by the menu deadline, and the groceries are ordered by the
  dinner. The DAILY_MAINTENANCE job emails the closest user of the chef while a deadline is missed, listing all the
  dinner's deadlines. A dinner with all its deadlines met sends nothing.

elements.name: The DAILY_MAINTENANCE job emails the chef's missed deadlines once

steps.name: the admin is signed in
a season of its own is active
a dinner past its ANNOUNCED deadline
the dinner is in the state SCHEDULED
the dinner has 0 expenses
the DAILY_MAINTENANCE job has run 1 time
the DAILY_MAINTENANCE job runs
1 CHEF_DINNER_DEADLINES delivery record is in the database for the dinner
1 CHEF_DINNER_DEADLINES email is sent to the closest user of the chef

elements.name: The delivery dry run counts the chef's missed-deadline email before the job sends it

steps.name: the admin is signed in
a season of its own is active

the dinner has 0 expenses
the admin runs the delivery dry run of CHEF_DEADLINES
the delivery dry run counts 1 CHEF_DINNER_DEADLINES email to send to the closest user of the chef
0 delivery records are in the database for the dinner
